record.one_liner: Netlify provides a REST API to manage atomic deploys, form submissions, DNS, and sites using OAuth2 and bearer tokens.

auth_methods.quote: Netlify uses OAuth2 for authentication authentication The process of verifying who someone is before letting them access your site. × . All requests must use HTTPS HTTPS The secure protocol, enabled by SSL, that encrypts data transferred between a browser and your site. × . To generate a personal access token personal access token A credential tied to your personal account that lets tools and scripts act on your behalf without your password. × (PAT PAT Short for personal access token, a credential tied to your personal account. × ): Go to Applications > Personal access tokens .

access_test.quote: To generate a personal access token personal access token A credential tied to your personal account that lets tools and scripts act on your behalf without your password. × (PAT PAT Short for personal access token, a credential tied to your personal account. × ): Go to Applications > Personal access tokens .

access_ship.quote: If you’re making a public integration with Netlify for others to enjoy, you must use OAuth2. This allows users to authorize your application to use Netlify on their behalf without having to copy/paste API tokens or touch sensitive login info.

api_type.quote: Use the Netlify REST API to manage atomic deploys of your sites and apps, manage form submissions, inject JavaScript snippets, manage DNS

api_breadth.quote: Use the Netlify REST API to manage atomic deploys of your sites and apps, manage form submissions, inject JavaScript snippets, manage DNS DNS The system that translates a domain name like yoursite.com into the address computers use to find your site. × , and so much more.
